report:
Liver, segment 6, resection

Received in formalin is a partial hepatectomy specimen (segment 6) measuring 110 x 80 x 55 mm and weighing 210 g. There is a single tumour measuring 80 x 70 x 65 mm. The tumour is ill defined and reaches the parenchymal margin; tumour thrombus fills the right portal vein. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-4) Tumour.
(5) Tumour with nearest parenchymal margin.
(6) Background liver.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Partial hepatectomy, minor (less than 3 segments)
- Tumour site: Segment 6
- Tumour focality: Solitary
- Tumour size: 8 cm (largest tumour, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Hepatocellular carcinoma
- Histologic grade: G2: Moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated hepatocellular carcinoma, invading a major branch of the portal vein. The tumour cells are hepatocyte-like, with moderate nuclear atypia, and grow in thickened trabeculae and pseudoglandular structures.
- Tumour extension: Tumour involves a major branch of the portal vein
- Satellitosis: Not identified
- Vascular invasion: Present, large vessel invasion (major branch of hepatic
  vein or portal vein)
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Parenchymal margin: Involved by invasive carcinoma

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 2 examined; 0 involved
  - Number examined: 2
  - Number involved: 0

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT4 pN0
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIIB

Additional findings
- Fibrosis (NASH CRN stage 3)
- Steatohepatitis (steatosis about 30% of the parenchyma)

LIVER, segment 6, resection
- Moderately differentiated HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA
- Stage pT4 pN0 (pTNM, AJCC 8th edition)
- Margin involved
- 0 of 2 regional lymph nodes involved
